compiled_build_recipe: Extract git archive 78050a30eda33fde61399cf331ca7542da0e0e7d r-package/dtatools into a new private source directory.
Apply the selected candidate patch at that archive root.
The package build invokes cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --config rust/cargo-config.toml --release --locked --offline with a private CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
compiled_build_recipe_scope: Representative reconstruction recipe, not an assertion of identical historical flags for every build. Candidate build_recipe entries record confirmed flags where available. Combined-v1 historically omitted --install-tests.
privacy: Records and patches contain no private home, temporary or dataset-cache paths.
repeated_capture: Recorder verified unchanged source, installed files, build logs, prior record, private configuration and recorder hashes across its before/after captures.
snapshot_scope: Bindings describe the exact frozen build snapshots, not later uncompiled NEWS, documentation or test-manifest edits.
startup_build_recipe: From the base tree plus startup.patch, copy DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, R, inst, man, tests and tools into a new R-only package directory. Do not include src or configure.
Copy the retained baseline DLL into inst/libs/dtatools.so and verify its SHA256 against the baseline binding.
startup_build_recipe_scope: Reconstructed minimum recipe. No exact historical extra-flag spelling is asserted; the retained install log shows only R/inst/tests installation and byte-compilation.
startup_native_binding: The R-only candidate reuses the exact retained baseline DLL. It is not represented as a newly compiled native library.
toolchain_scope: Versions are observed when recording. They are not a claim that the current executable hashes identify the historical compiler. Historical build logs are separately hashed.
